name: Introduction to Data Structures & Big O Notation
description: Overview of common data structures and their use cases. Understanding time and space complexity using Big O notation (O(1), O(log n), O(n), O(n log n), O(n^2)) to evaluate data structure efficiency.

name: Arrays & Multi-dimensional Arrays
description: Linear data representation in memory, static vs dynamic allocation, traversal, insertion, deletion operations, and two-dimensional arrays.

name: Linked Lists (Single & Double)
description: Dynamic data structures using Nodes and Pointers. Implementation of Single Linked List and Double Linked List, including insertion and deletion at the head, middle, and tail.

name: Stack
description: Understanding the LIFO (Last In First Out) principle, Push, Pop, and Peek operations, and real-world applications such as expression conversion (Infix to Postfix) and Undo/Redo functionality.

name: Queue
description: Understanding the FIFO (First In First Out) principle, Enqueue and Dequeue operations, and Queue variants including Circular Queue, Priority Queue, and Deque.

name: Binary Trees & Binary Search Tree (BST)
description: Non-linear hierarchical data structures. Understanding Tree terminology, Binary Tree concepts, BST operations (insert, search, delete), and tree traversal methods (Inorder, Preorder, Postorder).

name: Graphs & Representations
description: Representing non-linear network data using Graphs. Understanding Vertices, Edges, direction, and graph representations using Adjacency Matrix and Adjacency List.

name: Searching Algorithms (Linear & Binary)
description: Linear search on unsorted data and Binary Search on sorted data, along with their Big O complexity analysis and practical implementation.

name: Sorting Algorithms (Basic & Advanced)
description: Basic sorting algorithms (Bubble Sort, Selection Sort, Insertion Sort) and advanced algorithms (Merge Sort, Quick Sort) with complexity comparison.
